ev.q: the trees they felled all contained a damaged ring dating from the exceptionally harsh winter of 1709

1.why: B段。traced a feature shared by many trees ↔ the trees they felled all contained a damaged ring；one season of extreme weather ↔ the exceptionally harsh winter of 1709。Leonardo（A）虽然也把年轮和干湿年份联系起来，但他说的是一根树枝，不是很多树的共同特征。

ev.q: began to wonder whether changes in the activity of the sun affected the climate on Earth

2.why: C段 Douglass。a question about the sun ↔ whether changes in the activity of the sun affected the climate；first became interested ↔ began to wonder … realised that he needed a record of rainfall。他是天文学家（an astronomer），这一点也是线索。

ev.q: Leonardo da Vinci observed both that the rings of a sawn branch revealed its age

3.why: B段。recognised that the rings in a piece of wood indicated how old it was ↔ the rings of a sawn branch revealed its age。A段说几乎人人都知道数年轮可知树龄，但那不是列表中任何人的发现；Schulman（D）测定的是具体树木的年龄，不是发现年轮代表年龄这一原理。

ev.q: Growing very slowly in cold, dry, rocky conditions near the tree line, some of these trees proved to be more than 4,000 years old

4.why: E段 Schulman。harsh mountain environment ↔ cold, dry, rocky conditions near the tree line in the White Mountains；established the great age ↔ proved to be more than 4,000 years old。Douglass 虽然创办了实验室，但寻找最古老树木的是 Schulman。

ev.q: contained rings that linked the two, allowing dozens of sites to be dated to the exact year in which their timbers had been cut

5.why: D段 Douglass。joined two separate ring sequences ↔ linked the two（现代序列与 floating 序列）；old settlements could be dated exactly ↔ dozens of sites to be dated to the exact year。本题与第2题都选 C。Libby（E）出现在F段，与考古遗址定年无关，是从未被选的选项。

ev.q: he realised that he needed a record of rainfall far longer than any written one

6.why: C段。evidence of rainfall going back further than ___ records ↔ a record of rainfall far longer than any written one。不要填 rainfall（题干已出现）。

ev.q: when a charred beam found at Show Low, Arizona, contained rings that linked the two

7.why: D段。a burnt timber ↔ a charred beam；1929 年发现地点是 Show Low。只填 Arizona 不够具体（C段的 Lowell Observatory 和E段的大学也都在亚利桑那州），且 Show Low, Arizona 超过两个词，所以答案是 Show Low。

ev.q: one, later named Methuselah, was found in 1957 to be over 4,700

8.why: E段。1957 年测定树龄超过 4,700 年的那棵树后来被命名为 Methuselah。不要填 bristlecone pines（那是树种，不是那一棵树）。

ev.q: they were used to calibrate radiocarbon dates, correcting errors of several centuries for some periods

9.why: F段。tree rings help to ___ its dates ↔ they were used to calibrate radiocarbon dates。correct 也出现在同句（correcting errors），但原文是 correcting errors，填 correct 不是原词形，答案应为 calibrate。

ev.q: a tree adds a new layer of wood just beneath its bark

10.why: A段。lays down a fresh layer of wood immediately under its ↔ adds a new layer of wood just beneath its bark。trunk 也在同段（rings in its trunk），但新木层是长在树皮下，而不是“树干下”。

ev.q: darker, denser wood later in the summer

11.why: A段。the wood produced later ↔ later in the summer；darker and ___ ↔ darker, denser。与之相对的是早材的 pale, open（题干已改写为 light in colour and open in texture）。

ev.q: where water rather than temperature limits growth

12.why: C段。growth is limited chiefly by the supply of ___, not by warmth ↔ where water rather than temperature limits growth。同段 ring widths rise and fall with rainfall 表达同一意思，所以 rainfall 也可接受。temperature 是被排除的一方（not by warmth）。

ev.q: He called the technique of matching these patterns between different trees cross-dating

13.why: C段。the process of comparing these patterns is called ↔ called the technique of matching these patterns … cross-dating。radiocarbon dating 是F段的另一种方法，不能填。
